query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'file_id',file_id,'state',CASE WHEN state='reserved' AND created_at<=now()-interval '60 seconds' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE state END,'size_bytes',size_bytes,'media_type',media_type,'sha256',sha256) AS "data!" FROM assistant_uploads WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND session_id=$2 AND id=$3
